no_ship: No ship yet — the GM will add one in the campaign database.

paste.set: The image will become the ship image.

no_reference: Ship reference not loaded — ratings, marks and notes are available.

shot.replace: replace image — or paste with Ctrl+V

xp_empty: Pick a ship type to see the xp triggers.
upkeep_now: now ({{sys}} + {{rank}}) / 4 — paid at the start of each downtime
sys_empty: No modules for this system in the reference.
upgrades_empty: Pick a ship type to see the upgrades.
talents_empty: Pick a ship type to see the special abilities.
contacts_empty: No contacts — the GM and crew pick them from NPCs.
contact_pick: Who to add to crew contacts

builder.note: Over the {{type}} book: editing a section replaces its values, “to the book” restores them. The ship type is chosen on its sheet.
builder.power_hint: The second book number, as in “engines (1/4)”: how high quality can grow. That many quality and damage boxes on the sheet.
builder.xp_ph: what the crew earns xp for
builder.reset_all_title: reset all sections to the reference and apply the stock loadout
builder.reset_all_ask: Restore every section of the template from the book?
builder.note_custom: Custom ship without a book type — fill the sections here. The ship type is chosen on its sheet.
